About the Rapha Melbourne Mt Pleasant Ride group ride

Rapha Melbourne Mt Pleasant Ride is a road group ride in Melbourne, Australia. It rolls every Saturday at 7:30 am local time from Melbourne Guide Dogs, Kew.

A classic Melbourne road ride from Kew with rolling hills, scenic roads and the Mt P climb. It is for intermediate riders and open to non-members.
